paragraphs.en: A second-rank dragon and silver drops can target the gold beside a Yagura king. Different gold retreats require different continuations: capture and reinforce in one line, sacrifice the dragon in another. A defensive gold in hand can invalidate the familiar nonchecking silver drop, so inspect both players’ hands before selecting a memorized attacking sequence.

paragraphs.ja: 持駒が豊富なら、銀の王手で玉を引き出して金・角・桂を使う寄せを考えます。歩頭の桂で最後の金打ちの場所を作る手順もあります。銀一枚だけなら別の金を狙って角を狭める攻めも候補です。詰みと、囲いを乱して駒得する攻めを区別しましょう。
paragraphs.en: With sufficient pieces in hand, a checking silver sacrifice can draw the king out for gold, bishop, and knight cooperation. A knight above a pawn may clear the finishing drop square. With only one silver, attacking another gold can instead restrict the bishop and win material. Distinguish a forced mate from an attack that merely damages the castle.

question.ja: 同じ銀打ちが失敗する要因は？
question.en: What can make the same silver drop fail?

answer.ja: 相手の持駒が増え、金打ちなどの新しい受けができることです。
answer.en: Additional defensive pieces in hand can provide a new gold-drop defense.

title.ja: 矢倉囲い崩しの手筋②　玉頭攻めと端攻め
title.en: Breaking Yagura from the head and edge

paragraphs.ja: 端の位を使う攻めでは歩を連打して香を吊り上げ、隅の銀捨てで玉を移します。香を十分に動かす前に銀を捨てると、次の龍の攻めが詰めろにならない場合があります。似た順でも、最後に金を打つ地点が空くかを確認しましょう。
paragraphs.en: An advanced edge pawn supports repeated pawn taps that draw the lance forward. A corner silver sacrifice can then move the king away from its defenders. Sacrificing the silver before displacing the lance far enough may leave the rook continuation without a mating threat. Verify the final gold-drop square rather than relying on a similar-looking sequence.

paragraphs.ja: 玉頭では歩頭の桂や香の成り込みを、横の龍と組み合わせます。金で取る場合と玉で取る場合の違いを読み、取った金や桂を寄せに再利用します。玉を下段へ落とすのが基本でも、上へ誘って守りから離す方が速い局面もあるので、格言だけで判断しません。
paragraphs.en: At the king’s head, a knight above a pawn or a promoting lance can cooperate with a dragon from the side. Calculate separately when a gold captures and when the king captures, reusing captured golds or knights in the finish. Although forcing a king backward is often useful, drawing it forward away from its guards can sometimes be faster.

question.ja: 端の銀捨ての前に香を動かす理由は？
question.en: Why displace the lance before the corner silver sacrifice?

answer.ja: 後の金打ちの地点を確保し、龍の攻めを詰めろにするためです。
answer.en: It clears the gold-drop square needed to make the ensuing dragon attack a mating threat.

title.ja: 穴熊崩しの手筋

paragraphs.ja: 穴熊の２筋には香・桂・叩きの歩を集中します。継ぎ歩で相手の歩を進め、垂れ歩を拠点にして金銀桂を打ち込む構想もあります。相手が歩を取らずに守りを足す受けを読み、龍を切ってと金を作る攻めと比較します。
paragraphs.en: Attack Anaguma’s second file with lance, knight, and tapping pawns. Successive pawns can draw the enemy pawn forward and establish a dangling-pawn base for further drops. The opponent may decline the pawn and reinforce instead. Compare that defense with a dragon sacrifice that produces a tokin; the attack depends on the actual guards and available hands.

paragraphs.ja: ３三への働きかけで桂を跳ねさせると守りの連絡が変わります。龍取りをかけられても逃げず、角を打って守備の銀を動かす手が有効な場合があります。角の斜線で銀の取り返しを封じる攻めも重要です。囲いが再生する時間を与えないように、詰めろの継続を読みましょう。
paragraphs.en: Working on the third-file entry square can force the knight to jump and disrupt defensive connections. A threatened dragon need not always retreat: a bishop sacrifice may displace the defending silver while keeping mating threats alive. Bishop diagonals can also prevent recaptures by exposing the king. Calculate continuous threats so the defender cannot rebuild the castle during a pause.

question.ja: 桂を跳ねさせる狙いは？
question.en: Why force the defensive knight to jump?

answer.ja: 穴熊の守備の連絡や、侵入を防ぐ利きを変えるためです。
answer.en: It changes defensive connections and coverage of attacking entry squares.

title.ja: 舟囲い崩しの手筋

paragraphs.ja: 舟囲いは銀や金の位置によって攻め方が変わります。３一銀型には二段飛車と５三銀を協力させ、角を足してから守備駒を交換します。角の位置によって攻防の利きも違います。玉に近い攻め駒を、働きが残るうちに急いで清算しないようにします。
paragraphs.en: Boat Castle attacks depend on the silver and gold locations. Against the back-rank-silver form, a second-rank rook and advanced silver can cooperate, with a bishop added before exchanging guards. Different bishop squares supply different attacking and defensive coverage. Avoid clearing effective attackers prematurely: keeping a piece near the king can preserve the finishing threat.

paragraphs.ja: ４二銀型には玉を２二へ誘って金を浮かせる送りの手筋があります。相手に角があると角合わせの受けがあるため、先に歩頭の桂で別の打ち場所を作る順を読みます。４二金型には控えた香や焦点の香打ちが候補で、玉・金・桂の各取り方を比較します。
paragraphs.en: Against the advanced-silver form, a sending sacrifice can draw the king away from its gold. An enemy bishop in hand may enable bishop interposition, making a preliminary knight sacrifice necessary. Against the advanced-gold form, consider a reserved lance or focal-point lance sacrifice. Calculate king, gold, and knight captures separately because each creates a different continuation.

question.ja: 舟囲いを見て最初に確認する配置は？
question.en: Which placements should you inspect first in Boat Castle?

answer.ja: 守りの銀と金の位置、飛車の段、相手の持駒です。
answer.en: Inspect the defensive silver and gold, your rook’s rank, and the opponent’s hand.

title.ja: 金無双崩しの手筋

paragraphs.ja: 金無双への端攻めでは、角・桂・飛車と二枚以上の歩を協力させます。香で歩を取る受けと銀で取る受けでは、香を吊り上げて銀を狭める順や、角を切って銀を打つ順に分かれます。必要な持ち歩を数え、相手の最善の受けまで読みます。
paragraphs.en: Edge attacks on Gold Fortress combine bishop, knight, rook, and multiple pawns. A lance capture and a silver capture lead to different plans: draw the lance forward to restrict the silver, or sacrifice the bishop and introduce a silver. Count the required pawns and calculate the defender’s best response rather than assuming the first tap must be accepted.

paragraphs.ja: 角交換後は、飛車取りと守りの銀への攻めを兼ねる角打ちや、筋違い角で棒銀へ利きを足す構想があります。玉のコビンは継ぎ歩と垂れ歩で拠点を作り、銀と桂を交換して飛車を参加させる攻めが狙いです。攻めの形を目標に駒組みを進めます。
paragraphs.en: After bishop exchange, a bishop drop can attack the rook and defensive silver together, or add support to a Climbing Silver entry. The king’s diagonal weakness can be approached with successive and dangling pawns, followed by silver-and-knight exchanges and rook participation. Build toward these coordinated positions, checking the required pieces and pawn supply before selecting the plan.

question.ja: 端の歩を取る駒によって何が変わる？
question.en: What changes depending on who captures the edge pawn?

answer.ja: 香を狙う順か、角を切って銀を使う順かなど、続く攻め方が変わります。
answer.en: The continuation changes, including targeting the lance or sacrificing the bishop to introduce a silver.

title.ja: 初段になるための勉強法

paragraphs.ja: 初段を目指す学習は、得意戦法、苦手戦型への対策、手筋、短い詰みの四つを柱にします。得意戦法は定跡書で体系的に学び、苦手な急戦や奇襲には序盤で崩れない対応を用意します。段級位はサービスによって違うため、到達時期や本を読んだ効果を保証にはしません。
paragraphs.en: Study toward first dan through four connected skills: a familiar opening, responses to difficult opponents’ systems, tactical techniques, and reliable short mates. Use an opening book to develop your main system and prepare practical answers to aggressive lines that currently cause early losses. Rankings differ across services, so study duration and book completion do not guarantee a particular rank.

paragraphs.ja: ３手詰を見つける練習では、相手玉だけでなく自玉の危険も調べます。本で覚えた手筋を対局で試し、失敗した位置を振り返って復習します。詰み形を覚えるのか、読みを深くするのか、利きの見落としを減らすのかを決めて練習すると、課題に合う学習になります。
paragraphs.en: Practice recognizing three-move mates against both kings, then test learned tactics in games and review the positions where they failed. Choose a purpose for each exercise: recognizing a mating pattern, maintaining a deeper mental board, or avoiding missed piece coverage. This ties practice to a concrete weakness instead of treating repeated puzzle solving as an automatic route to promotion.

question.ja: 学習の四つの柱は？
question.en: What are the four study priorities?

answer.ja: 得意戦法、苦手戦型への対策、手筋、短い詰みです。
answer.en: Your main opening, difficult opposing systems, tactics, and short mates.

title.ja: 定跡書を使った勉強法

paragraphs.ja: 初めての定跡書は、初手から説明され、大きな図で重要な分岐を追える本を選びます。まず全体の構成と各章の狙いを把握し、複雑な変化を一度で全て覚えようとしません。次の一手形式と通しの解説形式では学び方が違うので、自分が読み続けられる形式を選びます。
paragraphs.en: For a first opening book, prefer explanations from the initial moves and diagrams that make the important branches easy to follow. First identify the overall structure and each chapter’s purpose; do not expect to master every variation in one reading. Question-based books and continuous explanations support different habits, so choose a format you can use consistently.

paragraphs.ja: 学んだ戦法を実戦で試し、迷った局面や本から外れた指し手を記録して戻ります。本にない変化は、駒の働きと王の安全を自分で評価してから検討します。出典は四間飛車、中飛車、石田流、矢倉、角換わり、横歩取りの入門書を挙げており、自分の得意戦法に対応する一冊から始められます。
paragraphs.en: Try the opening in games and return to the relevant chapter after a difficult position or an unfamiliar deviation. Evaluate piece activity and king safety before checking analysis. The source lists introductions to Fourth File Rook, Central Rook, Ishida, Yagura, Bishop Exchange, and Side Pawn Capture. Start with the system you actually play and use games to guide deeper reading.

question.ja: 実戦の後に本へ戻る目的は？
question.en: Why revisit the book after a game?

answer.ja: 迷った局面を具体的な分岐に結びつけ、指し手の意味を理解するためです。
answer.en: Connect the actual difficulty to its branch and understand the purpose of the moves.

title.ja: 終盤のコツと勉強法

paragraphs.ja: 終盤は囲い崩し、寄せ、詰みの三段階として整理できます。囲い崩しでは安い駒で玉の近くの金を狙います。寄せでは攻め駒を盤上に残して連携を強め、すぐに清算しない手も考えます。詰みがないときは、無理な王手より詰めろや必至で逃げ道を塞ぐことが有効です。
paragraphs.en: Organize endgame study into breaking the castle, assembling the mating attack, and delivering mate. Cheap pieces can attack the gold beside the king; active attackers should sometimes remain on the board instead of being exchanged immediately. When forced mate is absent, a nonchecking mating threat can restrict the king more effectively than an impatient check that drives it into safety.

paragraphs.ja: 三手詰で読みの基礎を作り、囲い崩しと必至の問題を組み合わせます。実戦に近い問題では駒を取る普通の手や駒余りも扱えるため、作品性の強い詰将棋とは役割が違います。自分が苦手なのが守備駒を剥がす段階か、攻めを配置する段階か、最後の詰みかを振り返ります。
paragraphs.en: Combine basic three-move mates with castle-breaking and hisshi exercises. Practical positions may involve ordinary captures and unused pieces, complementing artistic tsume compositions rather than replacing them. Review whether your losses arise while removing guards, positioning attackers, or finding the final mate. Select the next exercise from that diagnosis, keeping your own king’s safety part of every practical calculation.

question.ja: 詰将棋だけでは補いにくい段階は？
question.en: Which stages need practice beyond tsume alone?

answer.ja: 囲いの守備駒を剥がす段階と、王手せずに寄せを作る段階です。
answer.en: Removing castle defenders and constructing nonchecking mating threats.

title.ja: 詰将棋を利用した勉強法

paragraphs.ja: 詰将棋は詰み形を覚えるだけでなく、頭の中で駒を動かし、局面を正確に保つ訓練になります。王手と全ての応手を読むことで、長い変化でも利きや駒の位置を見失わない力を育てます。一方で、作品としての詰将棋だけでは実戦の囲い崩しや王手しない寄せを全て扱えません。
paragraphs.en: Tsume trains more than mating-pattern memory: it develops the ability to move pieces mentally and preserve an accurate position through a variation. Checking every defense helps maintain coverage and piece locations. Artistic compositions alone do not cover every practical castle-breaking or nonchecking attacking technique, however. Their training value depends on the skill you intend to develop.

paragraphs.ja: 実戦の終盤を鍛えるなら実戦形を、長い読みを鍛えるなら比較的易しい長手数を、利きの見落としを減らすなら短くても注意が必要な問題を選びます。実戦の詰みでは駒余りがあっても勝ちです。解答だけを暗記せず、なぜ別の王手や取り方が失敗するかを説明して復習します。
paragraphs.en: Choose practical shapes for game endings, relatively easy longer sequences for mental-board endurance, and short but exacting problems for overlooked coverage. Unused pieces do not invalidate a real-game mate. Review why alternative checks or captures fail rather than memorizing only the answer. Pair this work with practical attack and defense study so calculation transfers to positions without a forced checking sequence.

question.ja: 読みを深くする練習にはどんな問題が合う？
question.en: What problems suit deeper visualization practice?

answer.ja: 手数が長くても難しすぎない、局面を頭で追える問題です。
answer.en: Longer but manageable problems that require maintaining the position mentally.

title.ja: 5手詰のコツ
title.en: Moving from mate in three to mate in five

paragraphs.ja: ５手詰でつまずく原因は、初手の手筋が見えない、途中の局面を頭で保てない、最後の詰みを誤認するなどに分かれます。初手が浮かばないなら３手詰の捨て駒や守備駒移動を復習します。手数だけで難しさは決まらず、短くても難しい問題があります。
paragraphs.en: Difficulty with mate in five can have distinct causes: missing the first tactical idea, losing track of the intermediate board, or mistaking the final position for mate. If no candidate emerges, revisit sacrifices and defender displacement in mate in three. Length alone does not determine difficulty; a short problem can require more precise recognition than a longer straightforward sequence.

paragraphs.ja: 途中まで読めても続かない場合は、比較的易しい５手詰で局面を保つ練習をします。最後を間違えるなら頭金や一間龍を意識して１手詰と３手詰を解き直します。５手詰は短い手筋の組合せとして考えられることが多いですが、全ての応手を読む確認は省略できません。
paragraphs.en: Use manageable five-move problems when you can find the idea but cannot visualize its continuation. If your final position is wrong, revisit head-gold and one-square-gap-dragon patterns with one- and three-move exercises. Many five-move solutions combine shorter techniques, but this is a study aid, not permission to omit alternative defenses or assume a particular pattern must work.

question.ja: 途中の図を見失う場合の対策は？
question.en: What helps when you lose the intermediate board?

answer.ja: 比較的易しい長めの問題で、駒の位置と利きを正確に追います。
answer.en: Practice manageable longer sequences while tracking locations and coverage accurately.

title.ja: 初心者向けの棋書

paragraphs.ja: 入門書は数ページを読んで説明が理解できるかを確かめます。レビューは点数だけでなく、読者がどこまで指せるかを見ると判断しやすくなります。出典は羽生善治のみるみる強くなる将棋入門、符号を使わない将棋の指し方入門、将棋入門ドリルステップ、１手詰ハンドブックを紹介しています。
paragraphs.en: Assess an introductory book by whether you understand a sample of its explanations. Reviews are more useful when they describe the reader’s actual playing level. The source presents Habu’s introductory series, an introduction without move notation, the Shogi Introduction Drill Step series, and the Mate-in-One Handbook. They address different needs rather than forming a compulsory purchase list.

paragraphs.ja: ルールを固めたい人、符号が読書の障害になる人、問題を解いて覚えたい人、詰み形を練習したい人では適した本が違います。読む目的を一つ選び、学んだ内容を盤や対局で使って確かめます。出典の電子書籍の割引や読み放題の案内は、現在の価格や対象作品を保証するものではありません。
paragraphs.en: Choose from your immediate need: rules, notation barriers, active drills, or mating-pattern practice. Use the learned idea on a board or in a game to check understanding. Historical ebook discounts and subscription promotions in the source do not establish current prices or availability. The educational distinction matters more than collecting every volume or choosing solely from a high review score.

question.ja: 本を選ぶ前に決めることは？
question.en: What should you decide before choosing an introductory book?

answer.ja: ルール、符号、問題演習、詰み形のどれを学びたいかです。
answer.en: Decide whether you need rules, notation support, drills, or mating patterns.

title.ja: おすすめの詰将棋の本

paragraphs.ja: 詰将棋の本は手数と実際の難易度を分けて選びます。出典は浦野真彦のハンドブック、高橋道雄の実戦形シリーズ、飯野健二の実戦型シリーズ、羽生の五手詰を比較しています。１手詰で利きを確認し、３手詰で基本手筋を覚えてから、解ける範囲の５手以上へ進みます。
paragraphs.en: Select a tsume collection by both length and actual difficulty. The source compares Urano’s handbooks, Takahashi’s practical-position series, Iino’s practical collections, and Habu’s five-move problems. Use mate in one to verify coverage, mate in three to learn short techniques, and manageable five-move or longer problems to extend calculation. A stated move count does not promise an easy solution.

paragraphs.ja: 級位との対応は出典の学習目安であり、問題集を終えれば昇級するという保証ではありません。同じ問題を再び解くときも相手の全ての逃げ方を確かめます。５手が難しすぎるなら易しい５手の実戦形へ移るか、３手の詰み形を復習してから戻る方法があります。
paragraphs.en: Rank ranges in the source are study guidance, not promotion guarantees. On repeat attempts, still verify all defensive alternatives rather than recalling a coordinate sequence. If five-move problems are too difficult, try easier practical five-move shapes or return to three-move patterns before advancing again. The useful collection is one that challenges a specific skill while remaining possible to study accurately.

question.ja: 手数だけで本の難易度を判断できる？
question.en: Can length alone establish a collection’s difficulty?

answer.ja: できません。手筋、変化の数、形の見やすさも影響します。
answer.en: No. Tactical ideas, defensive branches, and pattern visibility also matter.

title.ja: 矢倉戦法の棋書

paragraphs.ja: 矢倉の本は戦法の全体像、駒組み、手筋、専門研究で分けて選びます。出典の序盤完全ガイド相居飛車編と矢倉・角換わりの教科書は全体像、矢倉の基本は駒組みと考え方、羽生の頭脳３は相矢倉の詳しい変化を扱う位置づけです。
paragraphs.en: Choose Yagura reading by purpose: an opening overview, development principles, tactical techniques, or specialized analysis. The source places the Static Rook opening guide and Yagura/Bishop Exchange textbook at the overview stage, Yagura Basics at development, and Habu’s Brain volume three at detailed mutual-Yagura study. These categories help match a book to an actual gap in your play.

paragraphs.ja: 矢倉囲いを極める７７の手筋は攻めと受け、これからの相矢倉は相矢倉研究、矢倉の新常識は急戦の研究に対応します。古い定跡書も基本形の意味を学べますが、出典が最新型と呼ぶ内容を現在の最新研究とは扱いません。実戦で現れた分岐を選んで読み、指し手の理由を説明します。
paragraphs.en: The seventy-seven-technique collection addresses attack and defense; Korekara no Aiyagura focuses on mutual Yagura, while Yagura no Shin-joshiki focuses on rapid-attack research. Older books can teach foundational structure, but the source’s description of a line as new does not establish present-day theory. Select a branch from your games and explain its move purposes before studying another specialization.

question.ja: 手筋を学ぶ本と定跡書の違いは？
question.en: How does a technique collection differ from an opening book?

answer.ja: 局面の攻め受けの型を学ぶか、駒組みから分岐を追うかが違います。
answer.en: One teaches recurring attacking and defensive patterns; the other follows development and opening branches.

title.ja: 角換わりの棋書

paragraphs.ja: 角換わりは棒銀、早繰り銀、腰掛け銀をまず区別します。出典のひと目の角換わりは初手からの基礎、角換わり初段の常識は基本形と４五桂急戦などの整理に対応します。角を持駒にした後の打ち込みの隙も、銀の進路と一緒に確認することが大切です。
paragraphs.en: Begin Bishop Exchange study by distinguishing Climbing Silver, Rushing Silver, and Reclining Silver. The source presents Hitome no Kakugawari for foundations from the first moves and Kakugawari Shodan no Joshiki for basic structures and knight-led rapid attacks. When comparing systems, inspect bishop-drop weaknesses alongside silver development; the exchanged bishop changes the tactical demands of the position.

paragraphs.ja: 角換わりの新常識は４八金・２九飛型、神速の２五歩型ガイドは専門的な速い仕掛けの研究に対応します。具体的な配置を理解してから専門書へ進みます。出典の最新という表現や必勝という書名は、現在の評価や勝利を保証しません。学ぶ形が自分の実戦に現れるかを確かめましょう。
paragraphs.en: The specialized guides cover the gold-on-4h/rook-on-2i structure and the rapid attack associated with the pawn on 2e. Understand the specific setup before treating their variations as reusable advice. Historical claims of novelty and a title’s winning language do not guarantee a current evaluation or result. Choose the specialization that actually arises in your own Bishop Exchange games.

question.ja: 専門書へ進む前に分ける三つの銀の形は？
question.en: Which three silver systems should you distinguish first?

answer.ja: 棒銀、早繰り銀、腰掛け銀です。
answer.en: Climbing Silver, Rushing Silver, and Reclining Silver.

title.ja: 横歩取りの棋書

paragraphs.ja: 横歩取りの本は全体の基本と、先後別の専門戦型を分けます。出典のひと目の横歩取りは入門、早分かり横歩取り定跡ガイドは両側の基礎を扱う位置づけです。飛車の位置と角打ちの隙を確かめ、覚えた一つの手順を異なる配置へそのまま当てはめないようにします。
paragraphs.en: Separate Side Pawn Capture foundations from side-specific specialized systems. The source uses Hitome no Yokofudori as an introduction and the quick opening guide for broader study from both sides. Track rook placement and bishop-drop opportunities carefully. A learned tactical sequence may depend on exact development, so do not transfer it unchanged to a superficially similar opening position.

paragraphs.ja: 最重要テーマは青野流や勇気流、相横歩取りのすべては相横歩取り、藤森式青野流は先手の攻め、超急戦のすべては後手の速い仕掛けに対応します。超急戦の本は攻める側だけでなく、罠を避けたい側にも役立つ読み方があります。出典の専門分類を使い、自分の手番と課題で選びます。
paragraphs.en: The thematic study covers Aono and Yuki systems; the mutual Side Pawn Capture guide focuses on that branch. Fujimori’s Aono book addresses the first player’s attack, while the ultra-rapid-attack collection studies the second player’s forcing attempts. A sharp attacking book can also teach the opponent how to avoid traps. Match the reading to your side and recurring difficulty.

question.ja: 超急戦の本を先手側で読む目的は？
question.en: Why study a second-player rapid-attack book as the first player?

answer.ja: 相手の仕掛けと罠を知り、安全な対応を準備するためです。
answer.en: Learn the opponent’s forcing ideas and traps so you can prepare safe responses.

title.ja: 三間飛車、石田流の棋書
title.en: Third File Rook and Ishida reading paths

paragraphs.ja: ノーマル三間飛車と石田流は別の学習対象として選びます。三間飛車のコツは四間飛車の知識を前提にする部分があり、三間飛車新時代はトマホークなど穴熊への専門的な構想を扱う位置づけです。まず自分が角道を閉じる形と早く攻める形のどちらを学ぶかを決めます。
paragraphs.en: Treat normal Third File Rook and Ishida as distinct study choices. The source notes that the Third File Rook tips collection assumes some Fourth File Rook knowledge, while the new-era collection studies specialized plans such as Tomahawk against Anaguma. Decide whether you need closed-bishop-diagonal development or an active Ishida setup before selecting detailed variations.

paragraphs.ja: ひと目の石田流は初手からの問題形式、石田流の基本の本組みと７七角型は本格的な駒組み、早石田と角交換型は序盤の乱戦に対応します。早い角交換で迷うなら後者の分野を学び、落ち着いた本組みを磨きたいなら前者を選びます。出典の新時代は現在の最新評価を意味しません。
paragraphs.en: Hitome no Ishida introduces the system through questions from the initial moves. The basic Ishida books divide into the established setup with bishop-on-7g structures and early Ishida/bishop-exchange complications. Choose the latter if early exchanges cause confusion, and the former for organized development. A historical book title describing a new era does not establish the latest theoretical assessment.

question.ja: 石田流の本を分ける大きな基準は？
question.en: What is a major distinction between Ishida study books?

answer.ja: 本組みの駒組みを学ぶか、早石田と角交換の乱戦を学ぶかです。
answer.en: Established development versus early Ishida and bishop-exchange complications.

title.ja: 四間飛車の棋書

paragraphs.ja: 出典は振り飛車定跡基本のキを、棒銀対策や相振り・角交換の基礎を知る入門に位置づけます。四間飛車上達法は指し手の意味と大局観を重視します。手順だけを覚えず、駒を交換する狙い、囲いの違い、反撃を始める条件を説明できるように読みます。
paragraphs.en: The source places Furibisha Joseki Kihon no Ki at the introductory stage, including responses to Climbing Silver and basic double-ranging and bishop-exchange situations. Fourth File Rook Improvement emphasizes reasoning and positional judgment. Read for why pieces are exchanged, how castles change the evaluation, and when counterplay becomes possible rather than memorizing an isolated move sequence.

paragraphs.ja: 藤井猛の四間飛車を指しこなす本は、１巻が急戦、２巻が居飛車穴熊、３巻が左美濃と藤井システムという構成です。渡辺明の四間飛車破りは急戦編と穴熊編で居飛車側の視点を学べます。相手側の構想を知ることも、自分の戦法の弱点を理解する練習になります。
paragraphs.en: Fujii’s three-volume series separates rapid attacks, Static Rook Anaguma, and Left Mino/Fujii System study. Watanabe’s anti-Fourth File Rook books separate rapid attacks and Anaguma from the Static Rook perspective. Studying the opponent’s intended setup helps identify your own opening’s weaknesses and timing constraints. Select the volume corresponding to the opposition you regularly meet rather than treating all defenses as one branch.

question.ja: 相手側の本を読む利点は？
question.en: What is the benefit of reading the opponent’s perspective?

answer.ja: 相手の狙う配置と仕掛けを知り、自分の弱点や反撃の条件を理解できます。
answer.en: It reveals their setup and attack, clarifying your weaknesses and counterattack conditions.

title.ja: 中飛車の棋書

paragraphs.ja: ひと目の中飛車はゴキゲン中飛車を初手から、なんでも中飛車は中飛車を軸に戦う入門として出典に紹介されます。戸辺流こだわりのゴキゲン中飛車は詳しい基礎、中飛車の基本ゴキゲン中飛車編は問題形式の基礎という違いがあります。まず飛車先と銀の役割を理解します。
paragraphs.en: The source presents Hitome no Nakabisha as an introduction to Cheerful Central Rook from the first moves and Nandemo Nakabisha as a Central Rook-centered beginner repertoire. Tobe’s dedicated collection offers broader foundations, while the basic Central Rook book uses questions. Begin by understanding the central pawn and attacking silver roles before comparing specialized defenses.

paragraphs.ja: 専門研究では一直線穴熊、超速３七銀、相振りでの左穴熊を分けます。一直線穴熊徹底ガイドと速攻ゴキゲン中飛車破りは居飛車の視点も学べます。対振り革命中飛車左穴熊は相振り向けの構想です。現在の対局で苦手な相手の形に対応する分野を選び、古い本の評価は固定しません。
paragraphs.en: Specialized study distinguishes direct Anaguma, rapid silver development on 3g, and Left Anaguma against another Ranging Rook. The anti-Central Rook guides supply the Static Rook perspective; the Left Anaguma book addresses double-ranging plans. Choose the topic from your recurring opponent’s setup. Historical assessments remain useful study context but should not be treated as permanently settled evaluations.

question.ja: 相振りへの対策を探すときの専門分野は？
question.en: Which specialization addresses double-ranging opponents?

answer.ja: 中飛車左穴熊の構想です。
answer.en: Central Rook Left Anaguma plans.

title.ja: 相振り飛車の棋書

paragraphs.ja: 藤井猛の相振り飛車を指しこなす本は、１巻が金無双中心、２巻が美濃、３・４巻が３三角戦法の応用という出典の分類です。相振りは対抗形と攻める向きが違うため、囲いの名前だけでなく、縦の攻めと端の弱点を学びます。全てを一度に暗記する必要はありません。
paragraphs.en: The source divides Fujii’s Double Ranging Rook series into Gold Fortress foundations, Mino play, and later bishop-on-3c applications. Attack directions differ from Static-versus-Ranging Rook games, so study vertical pressure and edge weaknesses rather than relying on a castle’s familiar name. Build understanding of the basic plans before attempting every advanced branch.

paragraphs.ja: 相振り戦の絶対手筋１０５は序盤から終盤の技術、囲いの破り方は縦からの美濃や穴熊崩しにも対応します。専門書は石田流の相振り編、角交換四間飛車最新ガイド、中飛車左穴熊へ分かれます。自分の飛車の位置と角交換の有無を軸に、実戦で使う分野を選びましょう。
paragraphs.en: The 105-technique collection covers recurring ideas across game stages, while the castle-breaking collection includes vertical attacks against Mino and Anaguma. Specialized reading divides into Ishida against ranging systems, Bishop Exchange Fourth File Rook, and Central Rook Left Anaguma. Match the book to your rook’s file and whether bishops have been exchanged; these conditions change the plans you can actually use.

question.en: What guides specialized Double Ranging Rook reading?

answer.ja: 自分の飛車の位置、角交換の有無、相手の囲いです。
answer.en: Your rook’s file, bishop-exchange status, and the opponent’s castle.
